acceptanceCriteria.text: Typed studioGuidedApi.ts for the 8 guided operations through the central apiClient. Types derive from v3. The MSW guidedHandlers/guidedFixtures are derived from contracts/v3 fixtures. A contract test asserts that each guided operation has a client method and a handler. Idempotency-Key is sent per D-1

One Run with three modes read from GET /tests/{id} readiness, never compileStatus. Auto-finalize at FINALIZING is a continuation with a stable key. Reconnect reuses the session. No hidden second execution. Not-ready is never shown as published
States and copy verbatim, with REPLAYING_PREFIX, PAGE labels rendered as untrusted, expiry warnings at 60 s and 20 s, and no sign-in, selector or DOM-upload state
LOGIN_REQUIRED, both variants, with the 'Go to step N' and 'Open Variables' actions. Guided half now; replay half after A1

Server-provided vaultSecrets capability (P1); ReferencePicker insert menu; SecretInput reuse; never-echo canaries assert the value is absent and the ID present; templates and onboarding follow the capability

Read-only 'Steps as learned' explanation. Learned versus replayed evidence is never conflated. PUBLISHED and currentReadiness are shown separately. Receipt reads go through the public result route only
Guided (getGuidedSessionVideo) and replay video with named per-step and per-action seek. Unavailable video gets a narrative, never a fake player

architectRulings.text: Per-test capability route, vaultSecrets = configured provider (not health), fail-closed, apiClient __doNotRetry, useStudioCapabilities hook; route, client, MSW and OpenAPI land atomically
PublicProgress on PublicSession and result through one GuidedPublicPresentationProjector. activeStep is null when no valid index exists; it is never inferred
PublicExplanation on the result, including failed and conflict results. Controlled label vocabulary, reference IDs separate, no values, honest provenance

Start refusals are inline, with no session: POLICY_NOT_APPROVED, REVISION_CONFLICT incl. BASE_IDENTITY_INCOMPLETE, MISSING_SOURCE, ORIGIN_NOT_ALLOWED, RUNTIME_INCOMPATIBLE, BUDGET_EXCEEDED. A start 429 may arrive as either the v3 error or the platform RATE_LIMITED envelope, and either way there is no automatic start

Test-only Node MSW proxy plus the real Vite app. No service worker. Add @playwright/test 1.63.0 with its lockfile through the package owner. Use a local non-secret WebM fixture with real range behaviour

Server start context from guidedStart in capabilities. sessionStorage recovery pointer key checks.studio.guided.v1:<testId> holding only safe IDs and keys. Retry the exact body with the same key; never fabricate a session identity

Finalize POST /studio/guided-sessions/{id}/finalize with body {schemaVersion:3, expectedSourceRevision, expectedConfigurationRevision}. C-int measures the operation count 43 → 44 and re-anchors the pins. Correct the stale runbook finalize paragraph in the same unit

delta.text: Send Idempotency-Key on executeTest (UUID), startGuidedSession, clarifyGuidedSession, cancelGuidedSession and finalizeObservedPublication. Keep it stable per logical operation

baseRevisionId = confirmedRevisionId; firstLearnStepId = firstChangedStepId as served, never after k. Show the four REVISION_CONFLICT messageCodes as not-ready start feedback. Send the closed start body. Learn again from step N uses step N's stable ID (source per A1)
NEEDS_RELEARN + readinessReason BASE_IDENTITY_INCOMPLETE: UX copy that does not claim the author changed steps, an explicit first-step boundary, no automatic full learn, and tests

Map FAILED + errorCode/failure.code to the AC-3 narratives. Partial and drift copies from relearnedFrom{stepId, driftSwitchStepId}. R4 whitespace-only expected ends ASSERTION_FAILED, with no client detection
The secret-fill copy appears only on the public discriminator from A2. Never infer it from INVALID_CONTRACT or diagnostic text. Test that INVALID_CONTRACT does not show it
Replay halves of AC-4 and the AC-3 drift copy wait for A1. Never parse diagnostic or message text
Every secretRef carries a pattern-valid secretId (the Vault name from listTestSecrets). No null, empty or alias fallback. Drop the MSW handlers.ts:173 name fallback. Tests
getTest(id) takes no parameter. Do not confuse the frontend v1 TestRequest type with the OpenAPI v2 TestRequest schema. Keep the STALE_REVISION/CSI_IMMUTABLE reload path
Action seek only from kind:action timings when video is AVAILABLE. No stamp, no button. Partial or absent guided video (KL-015-R1) and a null replay video status (H9) show the unavailable narrative
No guided start for a zero-step draft (structural count). A RUNTIME_INCOMPATIBLE refusal names no cause
'None of these' and a declined confirmation: cancel with userRequested, then focus step N. Never send a fabricated choiceId (pending A3)

constraints.text: Deploy constraint: never run or demo a post-015 backend with a pre-008 frontend against a real backend
No intermediate shared release between OBS-012B and OBS-008

Never-echo: no secret value in any rendered, mocked or logged payload. Canaries assert the value is absent and the ID present
Centralized transport only (apiClient); no direct fetch. No client-side intent parsing (ADR-SC-003)
Only independent @qa sets Done. Hand any push or PR to @devops
